---
title: "Report the study"
description: "Step 5 of the TVB-O spine: assemble the specification, its results and its figures into the document that goes to review, and go back to the specification when review asks."
aliases:
  - /phases/report.html
---

A run that stays in a results directory has not been understood yet. The fifth step turns the study into a document: the methods text that [③ Generate](../3-generate/index.qmd) writes from the specification, the result and analyses that [④ Run](../4-run/index.qmd) produced, and the figures the study declares, assembled into one report that a reviewer, a collaborator or your future self can read end to end.

Because every part of that document is declared in the study, the report is rendered, not written: a figure is a `tvbo:Figure` drawn from the result it names, a parameter table is read from the specification, and a methods paragraph states what the specification states. When review asks for a change, the change goes into the specification, and the report is rendered again. That loop, report back to specify, is the inner cycle of the spine; a study is shared only once it has held.
